speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer secondary to Chronic Venous Insufficiency. The patient's history of DVT, chronic bilateral leg swelling, family history of similar issues, and the location of the wound on the lower leg are classic indicators of venous insufficiency. The wound likely resulted from prolonged standing or elevated venous pressure leading to skin breakdown.
